reason: The PR is framed as a simplification, but it concentrates on core planner paths for index join generation and also touches plan-cache rebuild logic plus `pkg/util/ranger/types.go`. Index join path construction is optimizer-semantics code, and coupling it with cached-plan rebuild/range types raises risk of subtle plan-selection or correctness regressions beyond a narrow local cleanup. This is central planner logic and worth a focused deep review for High-severity mistakes.
